title: Akbar chupa rahe hai
body:
Shabbir aa rahe hai..(2)
maqtal mein..(2)
Shabbir aa rahe hai..(2)
maqtal mein..(2)
Shabbir aa rahe hai
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhme jigar ko apne..(2)
akbar chupa rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bole hawa se akbar, kuch khaak hi udaa de
seena ghame sina ke, lillah tu chupa de
hum zakhm kha chuke hai, wo zakhm kha rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kuch der neend karlo, jaage ho raat bhar ke
kuch kaam hai phuphi ke, kuch shaam ke safar ke
hum raasto ke kaante, baba hata rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aana hai gar zaroori, is dasht e be amaa'n mein
is abr e teero khanjar, is barish e sina mein
abid ko bhej dijiye, kyu aap aa rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Barchi ka phal hamare, seene mein kab hai utra
yaad aagayi thi sughra, seene mein dard uttha
seene pe haath rakhke, yaadein bhula rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sheh ne pa-e tasalli, akbar ko ye sadaa di
aye mere laal tumko, ab tak khabar na pohchi
sughra ka khat hai aaya, hum dene aa rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Akhir wo waqt aaya, shabbir ladkhadaye
ghutno ke bal wo chalke, laashe pisar pe aaye
bole ae laal uth jaa, hum khat suna rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Khat kya sunate maula, aansu bahake bole
wo kaise khat sunega, jo aankh tak na khole
hum aansuo se sughra, khat ko mita rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Barchi jigar se khaichi, ubla lahu ka dhara
akbar tadap ke bole, ruk jaaiye khudara
sughra se kya hai kehna, hum wo bata rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Laashe pisar pe maula, ghash khake gir chuke the
maqtal mein gunjte the, saidaniyo ke nauhe
rehan aur raza jo, dohraye jaa rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Jis dum suna ke baba, maqtal mein aa rahe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir aa rahe hai...Shabbir aa rahe hai
<<MINI>>
maqtal mein..
Shabbir aa rahe hai
